title: a fetch step at a scanned-index holder is blocked
line: the state marriage index the two grandparents cite, and one person's two citations of the New Jersey index, are blocked by their holder's kind alone (scanned index pages, no page-locating step built), the reason naming the holder; none of the four steps reaches the fetch list, and a turn on one of them does not pause

steps.say: the two grandparents' citations of the New York State marriage index (C08), and one person's two citations of the New Jersey marriage index (C09), are all fetch steps with mode blocked

has: the page-locating step is not built

expect.why: the holder's own kind (scanned_index) blocks the step, whatever the citation
the second grandparent's own citation of the same holder is blocked the same way
one of the person's two citations of the New Jersey index is blocked
the other citation of the same collection is blocked too
a blocked step never reaches the fetch list
the New Jersey index's blocked steps are absent too

steps.say: a turn on one of the grandparents does not pause on the blocked page

expect.why: the blocked step is never offered as a page to save
nothing pauses, so no state is kept
the step stays planned and blocked, not run, not logged
